saints.name: St. Willibald
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: An English monk whose long pilgrimage to the Holy Land preceded a lifetime of missionary labor…
biography: Born in Wessex about the year 700, Willibald was brother of Sts. Winnibald and Walburga and a kinsman of St. Boniface. As a young monk he undertook an extraordinary pilgrimage through Rome to the Holy Land and back, one of the earliest such journeys by an Englishman on record, dictated in old age to the nun Hugeberc.

Answering the call of St. Boniface, he joined the mission to the Germans and was consecrated the first bishop of Eichstätt, where with his family he founded monasteries and labored for some forty years. He died in 787 and was canonized in 938.
saints.knownFor: His pilgrimage to the Holy Land and mission among the Germans.
